findings.description: The opening exterior (0:00-0:10) establishes a white conventional sleeper-cab semi tractor with a long white trailer parked immediately against the diner's left corner with exhaust steam, implying the arriving driver's rig. At 1:43 the man walks to a dark green Kenworth day-cab (no sleeper) with a green/white box trailer parked farther out in the lot. The white semi is never shown again and no vehicle swap is depicted, so the established truck is silently replaced by a differently colored and configured vehicle.

A breakfast plate is already placed in front of the man at 0:38-0:44, immediately following the 0:34 food insert, and a plate still appears to sit before him in the 1:00-1:08 wide shot. Yet at 1:12-1:17 the waitress carries and sets down an identical breakfast plate in front of him again. No clearing or removal of the first plate is ever shown, so the same meal is served twice across the cut sequence.
